verdict.rationale: Alacritty's user data is mainly its configuration, which the docs say is a plain TOML file, an open format that can be taken elsewhere, and it supports importing additional config files. There is no documented export function, and the only way to get scrollback content out is manual vi-mode selection and copy. missing for 10: documented data export or portability feature, scrollback/session export to file, explicit statement that all user data lives in open-format files, independent corroboration of migrating away.
